complianceRules.name: Mandatory Statutory Document Checklist
complianceRules.description: All 8 mandatory documents (Land Title, Building Plan, Occupancy, Fire NOC, Structure, Faculty, Accounts, Anti-ragging) must be uploaded.

complianceRules.name: Fire & Life Safety Certificate Validity
complianceRules.description: Fire Safety NOC issued by State Fire & Emergency Services must have an expiry date beyond the current academic year cycle (31-Aug-2025).
complianceRules.aphClauseRef: APH 2024-27 Clause 7.1.3 & National Building Code Part 4

complianceRules.name: Contiguous Land Area Requirement
complianceRules.description: Minimum contiguous land required: Metro/Urban >= 2.5 Acres; Rural >= 7.5 Acres, free from mortgage or encumbrances.

complianceRules.name: Cadre Ratio & Teacher-Student Norm (1:15 / 1:20)
complianceRules.description: Undergraduate Engineering programs must maintain minimum 1:20 student-faculty ratio with cadre ratio of 1 Professor : 2 Associate Prof : 6 Assistant Prof, verified by Aadhaar.

complianceRules.name: Building Occupancy & Structural Stability
complianceRules.description: Permanent Building Occupancy / Completion Certificate from Competent Municipal Town Planning Authority along with Structural Stability Certificate.

complianceRules.name: Barrier-Free Environment & Divyangjan Amenities
complianceRules.description: Ramps with handrails, operational lift access, tactile warning tiles, and disabled-friendly accessible toilets on ground and upper floors.

complianceRules.name: Anti-Ragging Statutory Undertaking & Cell Notification
complianceRules.description: Affidavit affirming compliance with AICTE Regulations 2009 on Curbing Menace of Ragging, constituted Anti-Ragging Committee and Squad.

complianceRules.name: NBA/NAAC Accreditation for Intake Expansion
complianceRules.description: Intake increase exceeding 180 seats or new division requires at least one existing program accredited by NBA with minimum 675 marks or NAAC grade A.

complianceFindings.explanation: Extracted Fire NOC expired on 31-May-2024. A valid certificate covering AY 2025-26 is mandatory under National Building Code norms.
complianceFindings.recommendedAction: Issue immediate clarification notice to COEP for updated renewal NOC.

complianceFindings.explanation: Proposed IT intake expansion to 120 seats results in 1:24 faculty ratio, breaching the 1:20 threshold by 4 faculty members.
complianceFindings.evidenceSource: Faculty Cadre Submission vs Proposed Intake computation
complianceFindings.recommendedAction: Intake expansion cannot be recommended until 4 additional assistant professors are recruited.

complianceFindings.explanation: Deficiency detected: 1 mandatory document(s) missing: ANTI_RAGGING_AFFIDAVIT.
complianceFindings.recommendedAction: Issue deficiency notice to institution to upload missing mandatory certificates.
